items.title: Satoshi-era bitcoin faces a bigger quantum threat after Google’s new Willow breakthrough
items.summary: Google says its Willow chip can prepare the special quantum states needed for advanced calculations with about 40 times fewer errors, reducing one of the hardware bottlenecks behind any future attempt to crack bitcoin wallets.

items.title: Kevin Boon Succeeds Evan Cheng as Mysten Labs CEO
items.summary: Cheng will remain CTO and personally lead a new AI business unit building agent infrastructure tied to Sui and Walrus.

items.title: Strive’s bitcoin buying spree earns 27% price target hike from TD Cowen
items.summary: Strive plans fresh funding for bitcoin purchases as TD Cowen sees warrant-related stock pressure easing.

items.title: Tesla Roadster Rocket Is the Cool 'Flying' Car You Can’t Have
items.summary: Tesla's new Roadster flips through the air, jumps a row of Teslas and lands on SpaceX thrusters.
